summary: NDR feed s087_single is degraded due to 93.3% encrypted traffic exceeding 90% tolerance; all other checks (duplicates, one-way, drops, VLAN, overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: 93.3% of bytes are TLS-encrypted, above the NDR's 90% tolerance. Traffic is predominantly modern HTTPS/TLS without prior decryption, leaving payload opaque to the NDR.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs full payload for deep inspection. At 93% encrypted, it is limited to metadata/flow analysis only, cannot inspect payloads, signatures or JA3/behavioral detection, significantly reducing detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: NDR requires cleartext payload; deploy selective TLS decryption via packet broker/SSL visibility appliance and forward decrypted copy to NDR, or integrate key-sharing, to restore payload visibility while respecting privacy policy.
